checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Realistic wooden cabin among pine trees in dawn lighting
must.why: Realistic log cabin in pine forest; lighting is dusk/twilight blue, which is close enough to the dim dawn feel.

must.item: Camera advances smoothly toward front door throughout
must.why: Cabin grows steadily larger and door stays centered across frames.

must.item: Foreground trees shift relative to cabin, conveying forward movement
must.why: Foreground trees at the sides slide out of frame and parallax is visible.

must.item: Cabin and trees keep consistent shapes, no cuts
must.why: Cabin structure is consistent across frames with no visible cuts or morphing.
16:9 widescreen confirmed by frames; audio cannot be checked from stills.

faults.what: Lighting reads as dusk/twilight rather than dawn; clip is 5 s, not 6 s.

summary: A realistic, consistent snowy log cabin clip with smooth dolly-in toward the door and clear parallax; only the dusk-versus-dawn mood and low resolution are minor issues.
